import json, hashlib, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

def run(args,env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
key=hashlib.sha256(str(repo.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
runtime=root/"runtime/do_again"
state=root/"state"

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(repo/"src")
dry=run(["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(repo)],env=env)

def read_json(p):
    try:
        v=json.loads(p.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

out={
  "repo_head":head,
  "source_tree_hash":_tree_hash(repo/"src/do_again"),
  "runtime_tree_hash":_tree_hash(runtime),
  "runtime_matches_source":_tree_hash(repo/"src/do_again")==_tree_hash(runtime),
  "browser_status":read_json(state/"browser_status.json"),
  "liveness":read_json(state/"liveness.json"),
  "upgrade_journal":read_json(state/"runtime_upgrade.json"),
  "upgrade_dry_run":{"rc":dry.returncode,"stdout":dry.stdout,"stderr":dry.stderr},
}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SELF_RUNTIME_PARITY_AUDIT_OK")
